name: Boil Over

description.content: While the Killer is carrying you:

items: Whenever the Killer falls from at least [1.25m], you gain [33%] of your current wiggle progress
Your wiggling moves the Killer [80%] more.
The Killer cannot see the Auras of Hooks within [16m] of you.

description.content: Whenever the Killer falls while carrying you, you gain [33%] wiggle progress.

quote: "Buck and Wild/ Swing to be free/Your hands just can't keep ahold of me." -Kate Denson's Boil Over
